data.name: Ilmahtun
data.gender_notes: Ilmahtun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ilm' (knowledge). It refers to someone who is knowledgeable, enlightened and wise. In Islamic tradition, knowledge is a gift from Allah and a source of blessings. The name Ilmahtun carries the meaning “Knowledgeable, Enlightened” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ilmahtun usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable, enlightened and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Ilmahtun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledgeable, Enlightened.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ilmahtun total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
